title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover a range of study environments across the Tempe campus, from silent library carrels to collaborative student lounges and specialized academic halls.

cards.title: Silent Study with Brody Chairs
cards.subtitle: Hayden Library
cards.notes: Head to the top floor for a traditional library feel. Use the Brody chairs for integrated power, lighting, and high-walled privacy during long writing sessions.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, traditional library floor featuring specialized privacy seating and individual carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: Level 4 of Hayden Library offers Brody chairs equipped with light and power, individual study carrels, and comfortable seating with power outlets.
cards.source_title: Looking for quiet study space? We got you covered - ASU Library
cards.access_notes: Open to current ASU students; check library hours for daily access.

cards.title: First-Come Solo Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Noble Library
cards.notes: Find one of 55 individual rooms on the second and third floors. These are available on a first-come, first-served basis and provide a desk, chair, and outlet.
cards.short_summary: Dozens of private, single-person study rooms available without prior reservation.
cards.evidence_claim: Noble Library has 55 individual study rooms on the second and third floors available on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Study rooms in Noble Library - ASU Library
cards.access_notes: No keys or reservations required; one person maximum per room.

cards.entity_name: Design and the Arts Library Silent Room
cards.title: The Large Silent Study Room
cards.subtitle: Design North Building
cards.notes: Utilize one of the largest silent study rooms on campus. It features long tables and individual carrels specifically designed for focused, distraction-free work.
cards.short_summary: A spacious, dedicated silent study environment located within the Design North building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Design and the Arts Library boasts one of the largest silent study rooms with tables, comfortable chairs, and individual study carrels.
cards.source_title: Looking for quiet study space? We got you covered - ASU Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Design North; open during standard library hours.

cards.title: Near-Silent Nooks and Tables
cards.subtitle: Music Building West
cards.notes: Visit the west side of the third floor for a near-silent environment. This area is often less crowded and offers study carrels and comfortable seating.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area on the third floor of the Music Building, ideal for escaping central campus crowds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library provides near-silent study on the west side of the library with study carrels, tables, and comfortable seating.
cards.source_title: Looking for quiet study space? We got you covered - ASU Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Music Building West; check specific library hours.

cards.title: Calm Collaborative Lounges
cards.subtitle: Student Pavilion
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for a calmer environment than the first-floor hub. It offers open seating and a patio for group work or individual focus.
cards.short_summary: A sustainable, student-centric building offering quiet study areas on its upper floors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Pavilion's second floor and above provide a calm environment perfect for focused individual study.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spots: ASU - Untapped Learning
cards.access_notes: General building hours are 7 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. on weekdays.

cards.title: High-Tech Collaboration Spaces
cards.subtitle: W.P. Carey School of Business
cards.notes: Reserve one of 59 team rooms equipped with large screen displays and whiteboards. These spaces are designed for group projects and professional collaboration.
cards.short_summary: Modern, reservable rooms for groups of up to six people within the business school complex.
cards.evidence_claim: McCord Hall features 59 six-person team rooms equipped with large screen displays and white boards to support group learning.
cards.source_title: W.P Carey School of Business McCord Hall - KPF
cards.access_notes: Primarily for business students; check reservation portal for availability.

cards.title: Renovated Silent Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Durham Hall
cards.notes: Explore the fourth floor of this recently renovated building for a quiet study area. It offers a modern environment away from the busier central campus hubs.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, modernized study space located on the upper floor of Durham Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Durham Hall's fourth floor is noted as a silent study area following its comprehensive interior renovation.
cards.source_title: Durham Hall - ASU Business and Finance
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; accessible via the new gurney-sized elevator.

cards.title: Secluded Seating and Outlets
cards.subtitle: Interdisciplinary Science and Technology Building 4
cards.notes: Find a spot on the third floor for a more secluded feel. This area provides plenty of seating and outlets, often remaining quieter than the main libraries.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, less-trafficked study area with ample seating in a modern research building.
cards.evidence_claim: The third floor of ISTB4 provides a quiet environment with lots of seating and a more secluded feel than popular study spots.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spots: ASU - Untapped Learning
cards.access_notes: Building and elevators may lock after 5 p.m.; best for daytime study.

cards.title: Serene Study with a View
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union
cards.notes: Gather in this main-level lounge for views of Cady Mall. It features high-backed chairs and a fireplace, providing a serene space for rest and study.
cards.short_summary: A popular, comfortable lounge in the student union known for its fireplace and campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: Scoular Lounge in the Memorial Union provides a serene space for rest, relaxation, and collaboration with views of Cady Mall.
cards.source_title: Memorial Union Lounges - ASU Educational Outreach and Student Services
cards.access_notes: Open during Memorial Union building hours; check for seasonal fireplace use.

cards.title: Quiet Reading and Collections
cards.subtitle: Hayden Library
cards.notes: Visit the first floor for a quiet reading atmosphere. This room houses featured collections and exhibits, offering a peaceful alternative to the busier floors.
cards.short_summary: A quiet reading room on the first floor of Hayden Library focused on Arizona collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Luhrs Reading Room on the ground floor of Hayden Library provides an atmosphere of quiet and is open to all.
cards.source_title: Looking for quiet study space? We got you covered - ASU Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; open to all visitors during library hours.
